objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the local file inclusion weakness of a PHP personal blog whose page inclusion was patched twice and read the flag in /FLAG.txt.
hints: Find the parameter that names a file to include, and what the server does to the path before using it.
Check which properties of an upload the server validates, and where the stored file ends up.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets you make the server include or read a local file of your choice?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which feature is the way in to the server?
